sections.Profile:
"Solar Fire" is a pinball machine released by Williams in July 1981, featuring a space-themed design with four flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Part of the Williams System 7 series, it was designed by Barry Oursler and has a production run of 782 units.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1981
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
